name: log_escalation
description: Log why the call is being handed to a human claims specialist. Call this immediately before transfer_to_human when there is injury, theft, a coverage dispute, an API failure you cannot recover from, no garage in city, or the caller asks for a person. Do not call it for a successful FNOL the agent can complete.
pre_call_message: I am connecting you to a specialist.

reason.description: Short reason, for example injury reported, expired policy, caller requested human.
